summary: Preinstall hook downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload at install time
details: The package declares a `preinstall` script (`node setup.mjs`) that fires automatically on `npm install`. `setup.mjs` is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x...` wrappers, encrypted string constants) and constructs a URL to download the Bun runtime from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v<version>/<platform>.zip`, extracts the `bun` binary, and then invokes `execFileSync(bunPath, [join(D, 'math_init.js')], {cwd: D})`. The executed file `math_init.js` is a single-line 727KB heavily obfuscated JavaScript blob (numeric string-array with a rotating shift decoder `WV8StW`, custom-alphabet decode routine `hc1jfK9`, no imports, no exports, no readable strings). The advertised purpose of the package is a shared UI component library; the declared `main` (`dist/index.js`) only re-exports components, enums, stores, utils, and hooks, and never references `math_init.js`. The obfuscated payload is reachable exclusively through the preinstall lifecycle path executed under a downloaded alternate runtime, decoupling it from any code path a library consumer would review when importing the package. Fetching an alternate language runtime purely to execute a locally-shipped opaque payload at install time bypasses Node-based code review and scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
